formula: let score = 0; let vulnerabilities = 0; if (inputs.passwordStrength === 'strong') score += 20; else if (inputs.passwordStrength === 'medium') score += 10; else vulnerabilities++; if (inputs.twoFactorAuth) score += 25; else vulnerabilities++; if (inputs.publicWifiUsage === 'never') score += 15; else if (inputs.publicWifiUsage === 'rarely') score += 10; else if (inputs.publicWifiUsage === 'sometimes') score += 5; else vulnerabilities++; if (inputs.deviceSecurity === 'advanced') score += 15; else if (inputs.deviceSecurity === 'moderate') score += 8; else vulnerabilities++; if (inputs.phishingAwareness === 'high') score += 10; else if (inputs.phishingAwareness === 'moderate') score += 5; else vulnerabilities++; if (inputs.browserSecurity === 'enhanced') score += 10; else if (inputs.browserSecurity === 'standard') score += 5; else vulnerabilities++; if (inputs.accountMonitoring === 'daily') score += 5; else if (inputs.accountMonitoring === 'weekly') score += 3; else vulnerabilities++; let riskLevel = score >= 80 ? 'Low Risk' : score >= 60 ? 'Medium Risk' : score >= 40 ? 'High Risk' : 'Critical Risk'; return { riskScore: score, riskLevel: riskLevel, vulnerabilities: vulnerabilities };

educational.methodology: This calculator evaluates seven key factors in online banking security: password strength, two-factor authentication, public WiFi usage, device security, phishing awareness, browser security practices, and account monitoring habits. Each factor is weighted based on its impact on your overall financial security risk.
tips: Use a unique, complex password for each banking account with at least 12 characters
Enable two-factor authentication on all banking accounts for an extra security layer
Never access banking accounts on public WiFi - use mobile data or a VPN instead
Keep your devices updated with the latest security patches and use reputable antivirus software
Always type your bank's URL directly or use bookmarks - never click links in emails
Consider using a privacy-focused browser like Incognito Browser for sensitive financial activities
Set up real-time account alerts to monitor all transactions immediately
Regularly review bank statements and report suspicious activity within 60 days
